episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Five friends whose friendship goes back to their days in med school are brought back together when a phone call interrupts each of their busy lives.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: For the first time in 20 years, everyone's finally working under the same roof. A patient with a familiar name finds Chae Song Hwa.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: The hospital's med students are inspired by the doctors, who each look after their patients in their own ways. Lee Ik Joon gets a welcome visitor.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Yang Suk Hyung's aloofness frustrates someone on his team. Jang Yoon Bok and Jang Hong Do witness a surprising side of Song Hwa outside the hospital.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Jang Gyu Wool can't get one kind word out of Ahn Jung Won, who seems especially cold to her. A difficult professor joins the cardiothoracic department.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Kim Joon Wan waits for a response from Lee Ik Soon, who says she needs some time. Jung Won breaks painful news to the family of his longtime patient.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: An unforeseen problem just before a surgery forces Jung Won to make a tough decision. Meanwhile, Joon Wan is put on edge in the operating room.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Distracted by a problem in his personal life, Do Jae Hak struggles to get through the day. Meanwhile Chu Min Ha finds herself drowning in work.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: An urgent call sends Song Hwa rushing to the hospital to tend to a young patient. Ik Joon receives a plea from a desperate father.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Put in a stressful situation, Jae Hak looks to Joon Wan for advice on the right thing to do. Ik Joon accidentally uncovers an extraordinary secret.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Ik Joon handles a sensitive request from the troubled wife of a patient. A sudden piece of news threatens Suk Hyung's peace.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: As doctors and as humans, the five friends each face a maze of life's questions and decisions as they figure out their next steps.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: As life at the hospital goes on, the five friends' growing pains continue. Gyeo-ul is disquieted by frequent visits from a patient's mother.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Traveling to and from Seoul, Song-hwa takes on a VIP client in need of surgery. A woman with pregnancy complications fights to keep her baby alive.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: An urgent case involving a liver transplant between a father and son is brought to Ik-jun's attention. Jun-wan has big news for one of his patients.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Worries about Ik-sun plague Jun-wan's ever-busy days. While watching over a patient post-surgery, Heo Seon-bin experiences a critical lesson.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Gyeo-ul receives a disturbing noise complaint about one of Ik-jun's patients. Seok-hyeong opens up to Song-hwa, who gives him a piece of advice.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: From student to intern for Yun-bok and Hong-do, and resident to fellow for Gyeo-ul, every step forward comes with plenty of hiccups — and new learnings.
